items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 11 at 3:50AM AKDT until October 11 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow. Additional snow accumulations up to two inches. Winds
gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Southern Denali Borough.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Difficult travel is expected along the Parks Highway,
especially near Cantwell.
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency. Visit 511.alaska.gov or call 5 1 1
for the latest road conditions.

Motorists should use caution if travel is absolutely necessary.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 11 at 3:50AM AKDT until October 11 at 12:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow and rain. Additional snow accumulations up to one inch.
Ice accumulations of a light glaze.

* WHERE...Upper Koyukuk Valley.

* WHEN...Until noon AKDT today.

* IMPACTS...Reports of rain at 32 degrees or below will result in a
light glaze of ice, making travel difficult.
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 11 at 3:50AM AKDT until October 11 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow. Additional snow accumulations up to 4 inches. Winds
gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM AKDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...An early season snowfall is expected late tonight through
Sunday. Roads and especially bridges are likely to become slick and
snow covered.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 11 at 2:01AM AKDT until October 11 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow. Total snow accumulations 4 to 12 inches.

* WHERE...Northern Susitna Valley.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snow will continue overnight into Sunday
morning before tapering off.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 11 at 2:01AM AKDT until October 11 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow and blowing snow. Additional snow accumulations 2 to 4
inches. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph. Visibility as low as one
half mile.

* WHERE...Thompson Pass.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snow and gusty winds will continue through
mid-morning Sunday before winds diminish as a front moves north of
the region. The combination of snow and gusty winds will
significantly reduce visibility at times. Although

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 10 at 10:16PM AKDT until October 11 at 6:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 55 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
